definitions.gloss: earth, ground, the land, terra firma
definitions.explanation: Refers to the ground or land in a grand or expansive sense. Evokes the image of vast, open terrain. More literary and sweeping than 地面 (ground surface).

examples.japanese: {大地|だいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れた→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な{大地|だいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A vast expanse of land stretched out before my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{凍|こお}りついていた→凍りつく：11759_kooritsuku⟧{大地|だいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}け→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧{始|はじ}め、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}く→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, the frozen earth begins to thaw and new life sprouts.

notes:
{大地|だいち} refers to the earth or land viewed on a grand scale.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧: the ground surface (concrete, everyday)
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧: land as property or territory
- {大地|だいち}: the earth or land in a grand, poetic sense

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大地|だいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧: the earth shakes
- {大地|だいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}みしめる: to plant one's feet firmly on the ground
- ⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な{大地|だいち}: a vast expanse of land
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧なる{大地|だいち}: Mother Earth

Often used in literary or poetic contexts, nature descriptions, and when discussing landscapes or natural phenomena.
